svg.aria-label: AIWorkHub system block diagram: seats and MCP surface over a five-pillar control plane of intake and plan, context authorities, routing and launch, isolated execution, and review and promotion, above a durable runtime of callbacks, ledgers, audit and retention, all persisted in repository-local .aiworkhub storage.
svg.text: Observe → Decide → Delegate → Verify → Promote → Learn. One repository-bound control plane: no cloud account, no HTTP service, MCP over stdio only.
SEATS · WHO TALKS TO THE REPOSITORY
stdio child process, one per repository
independence = did not write the code
exact argv built per adapter id
a worker never finalizes its own card
MCP SURFACE · server.py — 143 registered tools, stdio only
switch or reload the route, never fall back
resolved through the registry, never from cwd
needfix · roadmap · cost ledger · storage retention
session / memory / KB never written directly
cards that overlap in allowed_writes are never launched in parallel
task_store.py · task_fsm.py — one id, real states
workforce_catalog.py — runners the account can use
workforce_router.py — cost and fit, not vendor
validation_runner.py — exact commands the card named
DURABLE RUNTIME · WHAT SURVIVES A CRASH
the manager reads evidence, then decides
exact pid identity, not a status string
a pin has more than one reader
STORAGE · <repo>/.aiworkhub/ — repository-local, nothing leaves the machine
write intents applied by the manager
Generated by scripts/generate_architecture_diagrams.py; selected facts come from package code and the local index.
